HF Packet 速度慢但覆盖远，适合长距离与应急场景。: HF packet is slow but covers long distances, suiting long-range and emergency scenarios.
Keep It Simple Stupid，TNC 与主机间的串行封装：0xC0: Keep It Simple Stupid: a serial encapsulation between the TNC and the host, delimited by 0xC0 with 0xDB as escape, letting software replace a hardware TNC.
VHF 主流：AFSK，mark 1200 Hz、space 2200 Hz，1: The VHF mainstream: AFSK with mark 1200 Hz and space 2200 Hz, at 1200 baud, 1 start bit + 8 data bits + 1 stop bit.
VHF/UHF 常用 1200 / 9600 baud，HF 常用 300 ba: VHF/UHF commonly uses 1200 / 9600 baud, while HF commonly uses 300 baud.
Winlink 用 Winlink Express 接入，支持 Pactor /: Winlink is accessed with Winlink Express, which supports Pactor / ARDOP / VARA and other protocols.
业余分组公告板，可留言与收发文件。: Amateur packet bulletin board: leave messages and exchange files.
业余分组通信的链路层协议，含源/目的呼号与校验。: The link-layer protocol of amateur packet communication, containing source and destination callsigns and a check.
以 0x7E 标志定界，含地址字段（呼号 + SSID，含扩展位）、控制与 PI: Delimited by the 0x7E flag, it contains address fields (callsign + SSID, with extension bits), control and PID fields, an information field and a CRC-16 check; the link uses NRZI encoding and bit stuffing.
基于 Packet 的位置、气象与短消息自动广播。: Automatic broadcasting of position, weather and short messages built on packet.
把数据切成带地址的数据包，用 AX.25 协议传输。: Data is cut into addressed packets and transmitted with the AX.25 protocol.
收发前确认频率占用情况，分组信号勿占用话音通联频率。: Check whether the frequency is in use before transmitting; packet signals must not occupy voice operating frequencies.
数字中继，按呼号路径逐跳转发分组。: Digipeater: relays packets hop by hop along the callsign path.
现代 TNC 可用声卡 + 软件（如 Direwolf）替代专用硬件。: A modern TNC can be replaced by a sound card plus software (such as Dire Wolf).
直接 FSK 调制（不经音频 AFSK），需电台有平坦的 9600 接口与足够带: Direct FSK modulation (not audio AFSK), requiring a radio with a flat 9600 interface and enough bandwidth; the ordinary voice microphone port cannot be used.
终端节点控制器，在数据流与电台音频之间相互转换。: Terminal node controller: converts between the data stream and the radio's audio.
通过 HF/VHF 电台收发电子邮件的全球网关，应急通信刚需。: A global gateway for sending and receiving e-mail over HF/VHF radio — a necessity in emergency communication.
